exposure: Women without a prior vaginal delivery
stage of labor dystocia causing a primary cesarean delivery
outcome: trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) success
cohort: Women who had primary cesarean delivery of singleton pregnancies for first- or second-stage labor dystocia and attempted TOLAC
finding: Nearly half of women with a history of primary CD for labor dystocia will achieve VBAC, with a slightly higher rate, particularly in those without prior vaginal delivery, observed in those with a history of second-stage labor dystocia.
mod_finding: Women with a history of second-stage labor dystocia have a slightly higher VBAC rate, seen to a statistically significant degree in those without a history of prior VD.
